title: The digest cover · the alley
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday's digest cover, week two: two spackle buckets in the frame shop's rain alley, empty, one grease sack between them. Tuesday's silence, kept.

panels.composition: A single image: the rain alley behind the frame shop, two upturned five-gallon buckets, an empty grease sack on the wet ground between them, vertical rain. No one.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a zine cover of two upturned five-gallon buckets in a narrow rain-hatched alley with an empty paper grease sack on the wet ground between them, no people, heavy black, no words
image.notes: Cover, week 2. The clams strip (dw_2000-10-10) as a still life.
